description:
[read-only] Read one saved ads data snapshot by id, or recent snapshot headers for the active brand. No cross-org access.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/ads/snapshots.)

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand. A brand-bound key is always pinned to its brand; any other value is 403.

name: ads_snapshots_get
title: Read ads data snapshots
